name: Chili Chicken Skewers with Ranch Cabbage, Apple & Cucumber Slaw
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

Pat chicken dry with paper towels, cut into 1-inch cubes, and season with spices. Thread onto skewers and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the chicken directly on the grill pan.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add the skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, trim and medium dice cucumber. Place in a large bowl.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apples. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl along with shredded cabbage and dressing, then stir to combine the slaw.
To serve, divide skewers and slaw between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
